donor_policy: Official FEC bulk Schedule A individual receipts of $200+ from indiv26.zip (plus cn26/ccl26 for committee linkage). MEMO_CD=X rows skipped. Names are copied from the filing extract only and are never invented. Donor lists are not sold. OpenFEC/DEMO_KEY is not used.
rules: Every fact has source URL + retrieved_at.
If sources disagree, show both and flag.
Never invent votes or donor names.

disagreement_flags.note: This extract keeps floor named votes only (aye with reservations, no, excused). Unnamed unanimous/majority floor Ayes are not expanded. Fully named committee rolls were retrieved but not shipped in the public file so they are not mistaken for invented floor Ayes. Both counts are recorded.
Distinct House names in floor named official status text. Not forced to 51.
Distinct Senate names in floor named official status text. A sitting senator with only unnamed majority Ayes is not invented.
